title: False-alias prevention for Shadow/Batteries/Honey/ZILL and adjacent numeric labels
baseline_note: The ledger was written when HEAD was ee608f7a12448a497d3295bf1649616693ffc5be. The session observed HEAD at 91a5ff7f2d9f94fa764115e4c875b6fb443bc453 at start and at e599b46b1c80929bb498d7079ad226566b5cabf0 before integration. Another session then committed these three M17-02 files at ffd148b342ff33c0a11682446a483dd992b8abd3 (parent e599b46) and closed the task at 656012ba2b31e862bfcf0d946ec1eec4ae0f99cf. git diff --stat 91a5ff7 656012b shows only TODO.md, unrelated app/test files and unrelated audit/data files; every file cited here is identical across the range.
method: Enumerate only alias and near-alias pairs whose two referents and whose non-identity decision already exist in this repository. Every row resolves at least one file:line quote and records the rule that would be violated by an automatic sameAs. No referent, alias, translation, transliteration or lore item is invented. A label is not a referent, a shared sound is not a spelling, and an unrecorded question stays NEEDS_SOURCE.

decision_definitions.REJECTED: A repository decision record, ratified policy, or explicit document states that the two referents are not one identity. The refusal is evidence and does not settle every neighbouring question.
decision_definitions.ALIAS_APPROVED: A repository decision record explicitly approves one surface as an alias of a named canonical identity, with reviewer and evidence. No row in this ledger uses this value because no such record exists for these pairs.
decision_definitions.DISPUTED: The repository preserves an open sameAs candidate or competing readings alongside a separation decision. Nothing may be merged, renamed or quietly promoted.
decision_definitions.NEEDS_SOURCE: Both labels exist in the repository, but no decision record, registry edge, reviewer decision or source locator decides whether they name one referent. Absence is recorded, not filled.

basis_definitions.REGISTRY_DECISION: A typed ontology identity review, graph candidate or UNILEX review records the decision or pending state.
basis_definitions.RATIFIED_POLICY: A ratified decision, the Blueprint ontology constraint, or the narrative vision states the separation directly, without a typed pair record.
basis_definitions.MISSING_SOURCE: Neither a registry record nor a policy sentence decides the pair; the row states what is missing.

SHARED_SURFACE_LABEL.description: Two referents carry the same surface label or homonym; a shared label is not a shared referent.

SHARED_TOKEN.description: Two labels share one prominent word; the remaining words name different narrative roles.

SHARED_SUBSTRING.description: One label is a substring of another; archive naming is not identity.

CO_LISTED_ARCHIVE_LABEL.description: Two labels are printed in one archive or chapter list; co-listing is not equivalence.

PHONETIC_RESEMBLANCE.description: The labels differ by one letter or sound; resemblance is not identity.

LEETSPEAK_SOUND.description: A stylised spelling (for example a digit for a letter) sounds like another referent; sound is not identity.

LETTER_SOUND_ACRONYM.description: A letter-by-letter acronym resembles a theological word; the expansion and domain differ.

NAME_SOUND_RESEMBLANCE.description: A fictional name resembles a divine name in sound or popular reading; a fictional band is not a divine referent.

MYSTICAL_HIERARCHY.description: A story taxonomy places one label above or beside a divine referent; hierarchy is not equivalence or authority.

MYSTICAL_RESONANCE.description: A symbolic word (wing, realm, level) evokes a supernatural order; fictional org or game vocabulary is not that order.

NUMEROLOGICAL_TEN.description: Two unrelated taxonomies both count ten items; a shared count is not a shared system.

NUMEROLOGICAL_HUNDRED.description: A game level number and a human age number coincide; numbers in separate dimensions are not interchangeable.

NUMEROLOGICAL_NINETY_NINE.description: A fictional role count and a theological name count both equal 99; the count is not the catalog.

NUMEROLOGICAL_MYSTICISM.description: A project framework number could be read as a hidden scripture cipher; the framework is not an esoteric code.

THEMATIC_METAPHOR.description: A literary metaphor or shared theme links two labels; thematic relation is not identity.

NICKNAME_DEVOTIONAL_RESONANCE.description: A poetic or personal nickname resembles a sourced divine name; a nickname does not become that name.

WHOLE_PART_MEMBERSHIP.description: A label names an ensemble and another names a member or alias inside it; membership is not identity.

VERSION_SCOPE.description: A member is included only in particular versions; a version-scoped surface is not a universal alias.

THEOLOGICAL_DOMAIN.description: A fictional or technical referent sits in a different domain from a theological referent; domains are not merged.

TYPE_DOMAIN_BOUNDARY.description: The two referents have different registry kinds or ownership domains; a type distinction is not an alias.

non_claims: No alias is approved by this ledger; alias_approvals and same_as_claims are empty.
No row resolves ZIIL to a single referent, aligns the ZILL creative and tasawuf tracks, or decides THE BATTERY versus THE BATTERIES.
No HONEY, QUEEN R, HONEYBEE or HONEY & MOON referent is identified, typed as a person, or linked to a real person.
No SHADOW alias, generation or real performer is named; IR-003 stays PENDING.
No theological referent is redefined, compared for authority, or treated as a data object.
No source text, lyric, manuscript, image or media bytes were copied.
No external repository, website or private witness material was fetched or consulted.
No canonical D04/D07 primary key or minted ARSY record is created by these referent ids.
limitations: The ledger covers pairs that repository documents already name; it is not an exhaustive alias graph for every ship, era, patch or crew surface.
Policy-only rejections (vision, Blueprint, ratified registry) are not typed pair records; they are explicit non-identity statements but carry no reviewer decision for that exact pair.
NEEDS_SOURCE rows record repository silence plus one or more resolving labels; they do not prove that the labels are distinct.
IR-003 leaves SHADOW character/workspace at DISPUTED even though a distinctFrom edge is approved, because the ontology candidate was never rejected.
ZIIL remains a disputed term; this ledger does not choose between the historical-spelling and safety/rights readings.
HONEY and QUEEN R have no registry row, so their rows rely on the vision's policy statements and M26-04's absence record.
The WINGS/AETHERION and 99/100 pairs are policy separations in XV documents; no game or org schema exists to enforce them at runtime.
No executable alias-resolution code, API or UI reads this ledger yet.
